    elseif cmdName == "永远天亮" then

        ValueHelper:SetValue(_controller,TimeValue.cd,999999999)
    elseif cmdName == "永远夜晚" then
        ValueHelper:SetValue(_controller,TimeValue.isDaytime,false)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(_controller,TimeValue.cd,999999999)
    elseif cmdName == "立刻饥饿" then
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.hunger,0)
    elseif cmdName == "复活自己" then
        GameHelper:PlayerRevive(player)
    elseif cmdName == "立即死亡" then
        local character:Model = player.Character
        if not character then return end
        -- local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        -- if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
        -- humanoid:TakeDamage(humanoid.MaxHealth)
        GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(player,999999)
    elseif cmdName == "切换昼夜" then
        local v_cd:BoolValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(_controller,TimeValue.cd)
        v_cd.Value = 0
    elseif cmdName == "不会饥饿" then
        local v_hunger:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.hunger)
        v_hunger.Value = 9999999
    elseif cmdName == "无限血量" then
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end
        local character:Model = player.Character
        local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        humanoid.MaxHealth = 9999999
        humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
    elseif cmdName == "满级营火" then
        local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
        for _,lo:CampfireSetting.Type in ipairs(CampfireSetting.data) do
            local v_level:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(campfire,CampfireValue.level)
            if v_level.Value < lo.id then
                v_level.Value = lo.id
                ValueHelper:SetValue(campfire,CampfireValue.heat,lo.maxHeat * workspace.GameValue:FindFirstChild("营火热度需求倍率").Value)
                task.wait(1)
            end
        end
    elseif cmdName == "火车CD归0" then
        local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("火车大劫案")
        if not folder then return end
        local v_ResetCD:NumberValue = folder:FindFirstChild("ResetCD")
        if v_ResetCD and v_ResetCD.Value > 1 then
            v_ResetCD.Value = 1
        end
    elseif cmdName == "摧毁火车头" then
		if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end
        local pointModels = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Train)
        if #pointModels <= 0 then return end
        local model:Model = pointModels[math.random(1,#pointModels)]
        local head = model:FindFirstChild("车头TakeDamageModel")
        GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,head,9999999)
    elseif cmdName == "摧毁火车门" then
		if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end
        local pointModels = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Train)
        if #pointModels <= 0 then return end
        local model:Model = pointModels[math.random(1,#pointModels)]
        local head = model:FindFirstChild("车门TakeDamageModel")
        GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,head,9999999)
    elseif cmdName == "传送火车" then
        -- local pointModels = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Train)
        -- if #pointModels <= 0 then return end
        -- local model:Model = pointModels[math.random(1,#pointModels)]
        -- local pos = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(model:GetPivot().Position) + Vector3.new(0,20,0)
        -- GameHelper:FastTravel(player,pos)
        GameHelper:TeleportToTrain(player)
    elseif cmdName == "传送加特林工坊" then
        local pointModels = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.GatlinWorkshop)
        if #pointModels <= 0 then return end
        local model:Model = pointModels[math.random(1,#pointModels)]
        local pos = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(model:GetPivot().Position) + Vector3.new(0,5,0)
        GameHelper:FastTravel(player,pos)
    elseif cmdName == "传送到沼泽地" then
        local marshGrounds = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.MarshGround)
        if #marshGrounds <= 0 then return end
        local marshGround:Part = marshGrounds[math.random(1,#marshGrounds)]
        local character:Model = player.Character
        character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(marshGround.CFrame.Position)))
    elseif cmdName == "传送到雪原" then
        local grounds = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.SnowfieldGround)
        if #grounds <= 0 then return end
        local ground:Part = grounds[math.random(1,#grounds)]
        GameHelper:FastTravel(player,MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(ground.Position))
    elseif cmdName == "传送到宝石塔" then
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end
        local towerController = MapHelper:GetGemTowerController()
        local character:Model = player.Character
        local CDPart:Part = towerController.CDPart
        character:PivotTo(CDPart.CFrame)
    elseif cmdName == "传送到淘金点" then
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end
        local goldpans = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.GoldPan)
        if #goldpans <= 0 then return end

        local goldpan:Model = goldpans[math.random(1,#goldpans)]
        local character:Model = player.Character
        character:PivotTo(goldpan:GetPivot() + Vector3.yAxis * 5)
    elseif cmdName == "传送到武器工坊" then
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end

        local mapParent = MapHelper:GetMapParent()
        local workshop:Model = mapParent:FindFirstChild("2x2,武器工坊")
        if not workshop then
            warn("[GMService] 未找到武器工坊")
            return
        end

        local targetPosition = workshop:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
        local ok, safePosition = pcall(function()
            return MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(targetPosition)
        end)
        if ok and safePosition then
            targetPosition = safePosition + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
        end

        GameHelper:FastTravel(player, targetPosition)
    elseif cmdName == "传送到驼鹿巢穴" then
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end

        local nests = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.KingMooseNest)
        if #nests <= 0 then
            warn("[GMService] 未找到驼鹿巢穴")
            return
        end

        local nest:Model = nests[1]
        local targetPosition = nest:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0,5,0)
        local ok, safePosition = pcall(function()
            return MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(targetPosition)
        end)
        if ok and safePosition then
            targetPosition = safePosition + Vector3.new(0,5,0)
        end

        GameHelper:FastTravel(player,targetPosition)
    elseif cmdName == "传送私酒工坊" then
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end
        local WineWorkshops = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.WineWorkshop)
        if #WineWorkshops <= 0 then return end
        local WineWorkshop:Model = WineWorkshops[math.random(1,#WineWorkshops)]
        local character:Model = player.Character
        character:PivotTo(WineWorkshop:GetPivot() + Vector3.yAxis * 5)
    elseif cmdName == "传送疯猪洞穴" then
        -- if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end
        -- local model:Model = workspace:FindFirstChild("沼泽"):FindFirstChild("野猪王战场")
        -- local att:Attachment = model:FindFirstChild("传送点")
        -- local character:Model = player.Character
        -- character:PivotTo(att.WorldCFrame)
        
	    GameHelper:TeleportToWildBoardKing(player)
    elseif cmdName == "传送疯猪入口" then
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end
        local pointModel = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.MadPigCave)
        if #pointModel <= 0 then return end
        local model:Model = pointModel[math.random(1,#pointModel)]
        local character:Model = player.Character
        character:PivotTo(model:GetPivot() + Vector3.yAxis * 30)
    elseif cmdName == "传送铃铛洞穴入口" then
        local lv = tonumber(params[1])
        local pointModels = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.BellCave)
        for _,model:Model in ipairs(pointModels) do
            if model.Name:find(string.format("%d级",lv)) then
                local pos = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(model:GetPivot().Position) + Vector3.new(0,10,0)
                GameHelper:FastTravel(player,pos)
                break
            end
        end
    elseif cmdName == "传送铃铛洞穴副本" then
        local lv = tonumber(params[1])
        local pointModels = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.BellCave)
        for _,model:Model in ipairs(pointModels) do
            if model.Name:find(string.format("%d级",lv)) then
                -- local pos = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(model:GetPivot().Position) + Vector3.new(0,10,0)
                local v_battleGround:ObjectValue = model:FindFirstChild("铃铛洞穴"):FindFirstChild("战场")
                local att:Attachment = v_battleGround.Value:FindFirstChild("传送点")
                GameHelper:FastTravel(player,att.WorldPosition,true)
                break
            end
        end
    elseif cmdName == "传送到圣诞老人据点" then
        local cc = GameHelper:GetChristmasController()
        if not cc then return end
        GameHelper:FastTravel(player,cc:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0,10,0))
    elseif cmdName == "宝石塔CD归0" then
        GameHelper.SetGemTowerCD:Fire(0)
    elseif cmdName == "野猪王CD归0" then
        local model = workspace:FindFirstChild("沼泽"):FindFirstChild("野猪王战场")
        if not model then return end
        local v_cd:IntValue = model:FindFirstChild("Values"):FindFirstChild("BossSpawn_CD")
        if v_cd.Value > 1 then
            v_cd.Value = 1
        end
    elseif cmdName == "牛牛CD归0" then
        local model = workspace:FindFirstChild("雪原"):FindFirstChild("牛牛战场")
        if not model then return end
        local v_BossSpawnTime:IntValue = model:FindFirstChild("Values"):FindFirstChild("BossSpawnTime")
        v_BossSpawnTime.Value = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + 2
    elseif cmdName == "铃铛洞穴CD归0" then
        local pointModels = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.BellCave)
        for _,model:Model in ipairs(pointModels) do
            local v_battleGround:ObjectValue = model:FindFirstChild("铃铛洞穴"):FindFirstChild("战场")
            local battleGround:Model = v_battleGround.Value
            local v_BossSpawn_CD:IntValue = battleGround:FindFirstChild("Values"):FindFirstChild("BossSpawn_CD")
            if v_BossSpawn_CD.Value > workspace.DistributedGameTime then
                -- 只归0正在倒计时的副本
                v_BossSpawn_CD.Value = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 2
            end
        end
    elseif cmdName == "制造台素材" then
        local amount = tonumber(params[1]) or 1
        local craftingBench:Model = MapHelper:GetCraftingBench()
        local v_wood:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(craftingBench, CraftingBenchValue.wood)
        local v_iron:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(craftingBench, CraftingBenchValue.iron)
        local v_gold:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(craftingBench, CraftingBenchValue.gold)
        local v_crystal:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(craftingBench, CraftingBenchValue.crystal)
        v_wood.Value += amount
        v_iron.Value += amount
        v_gold.Value += amount
        v_crystal.Value += amount
    elseif cmdName == "布娃娃测试" then
        player.Character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.TempRagdoll)
        task.wait(3)
        player.Character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.TempRagdoll)
    elseif cmdName == "今晚袭击" then
        local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
        ValueHelper:SetValue(campfire,CampfireValue.attackedCD,999)
    elseif cmdName == "创建马匹" then
        local name = params[1] or "普通马"
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local cframe = humanoidRootPart.CFrame

        local horse = GameHelper:CreateHorse(name)
        horse:PivotTo(cframe + cframe.LookVector * 3 + Vector3.yAxis * 3)
    elseif cmdName == "创建驯鹿" then
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local cframe = humanoidRootPart.CFrame

        local horse = GameHelper:CreateReindeer(cframe + cframe.LookVector * 3 + Vector3.yAxis * 3)
    elseif cmdName == "无天气" then
        ValueHelper:SetValue(_controller,WeatherValue.weather,GameEnum.WeatherId.None)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(_controller,WeatherValue.weatherCD,500)
    elseif cmdName == "雨天" then
        ValueHelper:SetValue(_controller,WeatherValue.weather,GameEnum.WeatherId.Rain)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(_controller,WeatherValue.weatherCD,500)
    elseif cmdName == "满月" then
        local v_fullMoonCD:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(_controller,WeatherValue.fullMoonCD)
        local v_fullMoonNights:IntValue = workspace.GameValue:FindFirstChild("每隔n晚满月")
        v_fullMoonCD.Value = v_fullMoonNights.Value
    elseif cmdName == "生成敌人" then
        local id = tonumber(params[1])
        local enemy:Model = EnemyHelper:Create(id,workspace)

        if enemy then
            local character = player.Character
            local startCFrame = character:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0,5,0)
            local startPos = startCFrame.Position
            local flatLook = Vector3.new(startCFrame.LookVector.X,0,startCFrame.LookVector.Z)
            if flatLook.Magnitude < 0.1 then
                flatLook = Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
            end
            flatLook = flatLook.Unit
            local dir = flatLook * 12
            local spawnPos:Vector3
            local raycastParamsH = RaycastParams.new()
            raycastParamsH.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            raycastParamsH:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
            raycastParamsH:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy))
            local mounted = enemy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MountedEnemy)

            if mounted then
                local probe = startPos + dir
                local groundHit:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(probe + Vector3.yAxis * 50,Vector3.yAxis * -150,raycastParamsH)
                local _,bounds = enemy:GetBoundingBox()
                if groundHit then
                    spawnPos = groundHit.Position + Vector3.yAxis * (bounds.Y * 0.5 + 0.75)
                else
                    spawnPos = startPos + dir + Vector3.yAxis * (bounds.Y * 0.5 + 2)
                end

                local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
                overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                overlap:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
                overlap:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy))
                local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(spawnPos),Vector3.new(bounds.X * 0.8,math.max(2,bounds.Y * 0.75),bounds.Z * 0.8),overlap)
                if #hits > 0 then
                    spawnPos += Vector3.yAxis * 4
                end
            else
                local hitResultH:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(startPos,dir,raycastParamsH)
                if hitResultH then
                    spawnPos = hitResultH.Position + Vector3.yAxis * 2
                else
                    spawnPos = startPos + dir
                end
            end

            enemy:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(spawnPos,spawnPos + flatLook))
            EnemyHelper:SetCustomOriginPos(enemy,spawnPos)
        end
    elseif cmdName == "解锁圣诞老人营地" then
        -- local v_day:BoolValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(_controller,TimeValue.day)
        -- v_day.Value += 1
        -- task.wait(1)
        -- local v_cd:BoolValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(_controller,TimeValue.cd)
        -- v_cd.Value = 0
        -- task.wait(10)

        local _cc:Model = GameHelper:GetChristmasController()
        if not _cc then return end
        local v_Stage:IntValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(_cc,ValueHelper.ValueModel.ChristmasValue.Stage)
        if v_Stage.Value < 2 then
            v_Stage.Value = 2
        end
    elseif cmdName == "解锁牛牛洞穴" then
        local flames = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.HolySpiritFlame)
        for _,flame:Model in ipairs(flames) do
            local v_heat:NumberValue = flame.Values.Heat
            local v_heatMax:NumberValue = flame.Values.HeatMax
            v_heat.Value = v_heatMax.Value
        end

        task.wait(1)
        -- 传送到牛牛洞穴
        local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("雪原")
        if not folder then return end

        -- 传送到牛牛洞穴门口
        local att:Attachment = folder:WaitForChild("山"):WaitForChild("入口"):WaitForChild("传送点")
        GameHelper:FastTravel(player,att.WorldCFrame.Position)
    elseif cmdName == "传送到老矿镇" then
        local mapParent = MapHelper:GetMapParent()
        local town:Model = mapParent:WaitForChild("5x5,老矿镇")
        GameHelper:FastTravel(player,town:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0,5,0))
    elseif cmdName == "主动保存数据" then
        DataStoreHelper:SaveUser(userId)
    elseif cmdName == "召唤小羊" then
        GameHelper:DeerTryAppear(GameEnum.DeerState.Nromal)
    elseif cmdName == "召唤饥饿小羊" then
        GameHelper:DeerTryAppear(GameEnum.DeerState.Hungry)
    elseif cmdName == "驱赶小羊" then
        GameHelper:DeerTryLeave()
    elseif cmdName == "传送暮年牛仔" then
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end
        if typeof(params) ~= "table" then return end

        local targetKind = params[1]
        if targetKind ~= "STAGE1" and targetKind ~= "CEMETERY" then
            UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player, "Invalid Old Cowboy teleport target.", UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
            return
        end

        local targetCFrame, questState, failureReason = getOldCowboyQuestTarget(targetKind)
        if not targetCFrame then
            if failureReason == "CEMETERY_NOT_READY" then
                UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player, "The cemetery has not been revealed yet. Accept the escort first.", UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
            elseif failureReason == "EVENT_NOT_SELECTED" then
                UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player, "The Old Cowboy event was not selected for this server.", UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
            else
                UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player, "The Old Cowboy teleport target was not found.", UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
            end
            return
        end

        local targetPosition = targetCFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0,5,0)
        local ok, safePosition = pcall(function()
            return MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(targetPosition)
        end)
        if ok and safePosition then
            targetPosition = safePosition + Vector3.new(0,2,0)
        end
        GameHelper:FastTravel(player,targetPosition)
        print("GM传送到暮年牛仔:", targetKind, "当前阶段:", questState)
    elseif cmdName == "传送到NPC事件" then
        local name = params[1]
        local eventModel:Model = MapHelper:GetMapParent():FindFirstChild(name)
        if eventModel then
            GameHelper:FastTravel(player,eventModel:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0,5,0))
        else
            warn("未找到NPC事件:",name)
        end
    end
end)"},{"id":297,"text":"
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local DataHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Common"):WaitForChild("DataHelper"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local BagHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("BagHelper"))
local ToolHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ToolHelper"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local UIHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("UIHelper"))
local AudioHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))

local PlayerValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.PlayerValue
local PlayerAttributeValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.PlayerAttributeValue

function updateBagTextByPlayer(player:Player)
    local bag:Tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
    if not bag or not bag:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bag) then return end
    local storeParent:Folder = BagHelper:GetStoreParent(player)
    local curNum = #storeParent:GetChildren()
    -- local size:IntValue = bag:FindFirstChild("Size")
    local size = BagHelper:GetSize(player) or 0
    local t_num:TextLabel = bag:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel",true)
    t_num.TextColor3 = curNum < size and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Color3.new(1)
    if t_num then
        t_num.Text = string.format("%d/%d",curNum,size)
    end
end

function onCharacterAdded(player:Player,character:Model)
    if not character then return end

    local storeParent:Folder = BagHelper:GetStoreParent(player)
    local updateBagText = function()
        updateBagTextByPlayer(player)
    end
    updateBagText()

    character.ChildAdded:Connect(updateBagText)
    character.ChildRemoved:Connect(updateBagText)
    storeParent.ChildAdded:Connect(updateBagText)
    storeParent.ChildRemoved:Connect(updateBagText)
end

function onInitPlayerVo(player:Player)
    if not DataHelper:IsInit(player) then return end

    local v_HorseBagSize = ValueHelper:WaitValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.HorseBagSize)
    local v_BagSizeBonus = ValueHelper:WaitValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.BagSizeBonus)
    onCharacterAdded(player,player.Character)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        onCharacterAdded(player,character)
    end)
    v_HorseBagSize.Changed:Connect(function()
        updateBagTextByPlayer(player)
    end)
    v_BagSizeBonus.Changed:Connect(function()
        updateBagTextByPlayer(player)
    end)
end

for _,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
    onInitPlayerVo(player)
end
DataHelper.onInitPlayerVo.Event:Connect(onInitPlayerVo)
BagHelper.BagStoreC2S.OnServerInvoke = function(player,item:Model)
    if item and not BagHelper:IsCanStore(item) then
        -- 物品不能储存
        warn(item.Name,"物品不能储存")
        return false,item:GetPivot()
    end
    if item and BagHelper:GetInWhoBag(item) then
        -- 在别人的背包里
        warn(item.Name,"在别人的背包里")
        return false
    end

    local storeParent:Folder = BagHelper:GetStoreParent(player)
    local size = BagHelper:GetSize(player)
    if #storeParent:GetChildren() < size then
        if item and item:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("储存/装备",player.Character.PrimaryPart)
		    -- AudioHelper:CallClientPlaySound(player,"储存/装备")
            GameHelper:Store(player,item)
            ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.dragItem,nil)
            return true
        end
    else
        UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"The bag is full",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
        return false,item:GetPivot()
    end
    return false
end
BagHelper.BagUnstoreC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,cframe:CFrame)
	-- AudioHelper:CallClientPlaySound(player,"背包出包")
    if BagHelper:Unstore(player,cframe) then
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect("背包出包",player.Character.PrimaryPart)
    end
end)"},{"id":298,"text":"local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local plantEvent = RS:WaitForChild('PlantTreeEvent')
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local treesand = workspace:WaitForChild('Prefabs'):WaitForChild('Map'):WaitForChild('树'):WaitForChild('TreeSand')
local treeseed = workspace:WaitForChild('Prefabs'):WaitForChild('Map'):WaitForChild('树'):WaitForChild('TreeSeed')
local treeS = workspace:WaitForChild('Prefabs'):WaitForChild('Map'):WaitForChild('树'):WaitForChild('TreeS')
local treeM = workspace:WaitForChild('Prefabs'):WaitForChild('Map'):WaitForChild('树'):WaitForChild('TreeM')

local stepTime = 60

function playDuang(model:Model)
	task.spawn(function()
		local originScale = model:GetScale()
		local t = 0
		local tt = 0.2
		while t < tt do
			local dt = task.wait()
			t += dt
			local alpha = math.clamp(t/tt,0,1)
			--local duang = math.cos(alpha * math.pi)
			--local base = 1 -math.abs(duang)
			model:ScaleTo(0.5 * originScale + alpha * 0.8 * originScale)
		end
		
		t = 0
		tt = 0.1
		while t < tt do
			local dt = task.wait()
			t += dt
			local alpha = 1 - math.clamp(t/tt,0,1)
			--local duang = math.cos(alpha * math.pi)
			--local base = 1 -math.abs(duang)
			model:ScaleTo(originScale + 0.3 * originScale * alpha)
		end
		--Enum.EasingDirection.
		model:ScaleTo(originScale)
	end)
end

local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local CommonEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Common"):WaitForChild("CommonEnum"))
local DataHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Common"):WaitForChild("DataHelper"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))

local purchaseHistoryStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PurchaseHistory")
-- 处理完成的提示与购买的函数
local function onPromptGamePassPurchaseFinished(player:Player, purchasedPassID, purchaseSuccess)
	if purchaseSuccess then
		DataHelper:AddGamePass(player,purchasedPassID)
	end
end

-- 将 "PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished" 事件连接至 "onPromptGamePassPurchaseFinished()" 函数
MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(onPromptGamePassPurchaseFinished)
-- 表格相关设置，含有产品 ID 和处理购买操作的函数
local productFunctions = {}

-- 复活自己
productFunctions[GameEnum.ProductID.Revive] = function(receipt, player:Player)
    if GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return false end
	GameHelper:PlayerRevive(player,true)
	return true
end

-- 复活复活所有人
productFunctions[GameEnum.ProductID.ReviveAll] = function(receipt, player:Player)
	-- 至少复活了一个人
	local reviveOne = false

	for _,otherPlayer in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if GameHelper:isAlive(otherPlayer) then continue end
		GameHelper:PlayerRevive(otherPlayer,true)
		reviveOne = true
		if otherPlayer ~= player then
			DataHelper:AddStats(player,CommonEnum.Stats.Save,1)
		end
	end
	return reviveOne
end

-- 复活队友
productFunctions[GameEnum.ProductID.ReviveFriend] = function(receipt, player:Player)
    -- if not player.Character then return false end
	-- local item = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(401,player.Character:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0,5,0))
	local ReviveFriendId = player:GetAttribute("ReviveFriendId")
	local revivePlayer = game.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ReviveFriendId)
	if not revivePlayer then return false end
	if GameHelper:isAlive(revivePlayer) then return false end
	GameHelper:PlayerRevive(revivePlayer,true)
	DataHelper:AddStats(player,CommonEnum.Stats.Save,1)
	return true
end

-- 核心 ‘ProcessReceipt’ 回调函数
local function processReceipt(receiptInfo)
	-- PurchaseId—唯一标识符。
	-- PlayerId—进行购买的用户ID。
	-- ProductId—购买产品的ID。
	-- placeidwherepurbought——购买的地点ID。根据用户在游戏过程中的位置，购买地点的ID可能与当前地点的ID相同，也可能不同。
	-- CurrencySpent—交易中花费的货币金额。
	-- CurrencyType—购买时使用的货币类型；总是Enum.CurrencyType.Robux。
	-- ProductPurchaseChannel——用户如何获得开发者的产品。枚举. productpurchasechannel之一。
	-- print(string.format("onProcessReceipt:%s",game.HttpService:JSONEncode(receiptInfo)))

	-- 检查数据存储，判断产品是否已经发放  
	local playerProductKey = receiptInfo.PlayerId .. "_" .. receiptInfo.PurchaseId
	local purchased = false
	local success, errorMessage = pcall(function()
		purchased = purchaseHistoryStore:GetAsync(playerProductKey)
	end)

	-- 如果购买流程被记录下来，则说明产品已发放
	if success and purchased then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	elseif not success then
		error("Data store error:" .. errorMessage)
	end

	-- 找到服务器中进行购买的玩家
	local player = game.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receiptInfo.PlayerId)
	if not player then
		-- 玩家可能离开了游戏
		-- 玩家返回游戏时将会再次调用回调函数
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	-- 从上面的 ‘productFunctions’ 表格中查找处理函数
	local handler = productFunctions[receiptInfo.ProductId]

	-- 调用处理函数并捕捉错误
	local success, result = pcall(handler, receiptInfo, player)
	if not success or not result then
		warn("Error occurred while processing a product purchase")
		print("\nProductId:", receiptInfo.ProductId)
		print("\nPlayer:", player)
		
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	-- 在数据存储中记录好交易内容，确保同样的产品不会被再次发放
	local success, errorMessage = pcall(function()
		purchaseHistoryStore:SetAsync(playerProductKey, true)
		-- 记录购物统计
		-- AnalyticsHelper:LogPurchased(player,receiptInfo.ProductId)
	end)
	if not success then
		error("Cannot save purchase data:" .. errorMessage)
	end

	-- OnProcessReceipt:Fire(receiptInfo)
	-- 重要：告知 Roblox 购买流程已被成功处理
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
end

-- 设置回调函数，这个设置只能由服务器上的一个脚本进行一次
MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = processReceipt"},{"id":304,"text":"local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))

function onRagdollTagAddedV1(character:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local ragdolled = false
    local jointsBackup = {}
    local originCollisionGroups = {}
    local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown)
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    -- local originWalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
    -- humanoid.WalkSpeed -= originWalkSpeed

    local disableTouchOnParts = function()
        for _, part in character:GetDescendants() do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CanTouch = false
            end
        end
    end
    local enableRagdoll = function()
        if ragdolled then return end
        ragdolled = true

        for _, joint in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if joint:IsA("Motor6D") then
                local socket = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
                local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
                local a2 = Instance.new("Attachment")

                a1.Name = "BallSocketAttachment"
                a2.Name = "BallSocketAttachment"

                a1.CFrame = joint.C0
                a2.CFrame = joint.C1

                a1.Parent = joint.Part0
                a2.Parent = joint.Part1

                socket.Attachment0 = a1
                socket.Attachment1 = a2
                socket.Parent = joint.Parent

                socket.LimitsEnabled = true
                socket.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
                socket.MaxFrictionTorque = 100
                -- socket.Name = joint.Part1.Name

                table.insert(jointsBackup, {Part0 = joint.Part0, Part1 = joint.Part1, Name = joint.Name, C0 = joint.C0, C1 = joint.C1})
                joint:Destroy()
            end
        end

        -- print("清空力")
        for _, basePart:BasePart in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if basePart:IsA("BasePart") then
                originCollisionGroups[basePart] = basePart.CollisionGroup
                basePart.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Ragdoll
                -- 清理掉身上的力度
                basePart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                basePart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                -- if basePart ~= character.PrimaryPart and basePart.Name ~= "Torso" then
                    -- originCollisionGroups[basePart] = basePart.CollisionGroup
                    -- basePart.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Ragdoll
                -- end
            end
        end

        -- 停止所有动画
        local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        for _,animTrack:AnimationTrack in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            animTrack:Stop()
        end
        

        -- if humanoidRootPart then
        --     local r = math.random(50,100)
        --     local a = 30
        --     local originOwner = humanoidRootPart:GetNetworkOwner()
        --     humanoidRootPart:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
        --     humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-r,r),50,math.random(-r,r))
        --     humanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-a,a),math.random(-a,a),math.random(-a,a))
        --     humanoidRootPart:SetNetworkOwner(originOwner)
        -- end
        -- disableTouchOnParts()
    end

    local disableRagdoll = function ()
        if not ragdolled then return end
        ragdolled = false
        -- humanoid.WalkSpeed += originWalkSpeed

        for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then
                part:Destroy()
            end
        end

        for _, attach in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if attach:IsA("Attachment") and attach.Name == "BallSocketAttachment" then
                attach:Destroy()
            end
        end

        for _, jointData in ipairs(jointsBackup) do
            local newJoint = Instance.new("Motor6D")
            newJoint.Name = jointData.Name
            newJoint.Part0 = jointData.Part0
            newJoint.Part1 = jointData.Part1
            newJoint.C0 = jointData.C0
            newJoint.C1 = jointData.C1
            newJoint.Parent = jointData.Part0
        end
        jointsBackup = {}

        for part:BasePart,collisionGroup  in pairs(originCollisionGroups) do
            part.CollisionGroup = collisionGroup
        end
        originCollisionGroups = {}

        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    end

    local enable = character:GetAttribute(GameEnum.Attribute.RagdollEnable)
    if enable == true or enable == nil then
        enableRagdoll()
        character:SetAttribute(GameEnum.Attribute.RagdollEnable,true)
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.TempRagdoll) do
            if not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
                return
            end
            -- print("ragdolling...")
            task.wait()
        end
        disableRagdoll()
        character:SetAttribute(GameEnum.Attribute.RagdollEnable,nil)
    end)

    table.insert(connections,character:GetAttributeChangedSignal(GameEnum.Attribute.RagdollEnable):Connect(function()
